svg.title: Hydraulic Fracturing Layout
svg.desc: Original illustration depicts shale-gas horizontal-well hydraulic fracturing, used as a general process picture. Tankers deliver water; pumps inject water/sand/chemicals; the well turns horizontal; pressure opens fractures, sand props them open, gas reaches surface storage, returned water goes for treatment. It mentions about 200 tanker loads and >1 million US gallons (3,785.4 m³). Those quantities describe the gas-industry illustration, not a Yuanwang geothermal specification. Key: 页岩 = shale; 气井 = gas well; 地下水位 = groundwater level; 储存罐 = storage tank; 裂隙 = fracture; 地壳深度（英尺） = subsurface depth in feet.
